select tpp.id as plan_id,tcp.project_code,tcp.project_name, ta.id as contract_id,ta.agreement_code as contract_code,ta.agreement_name as contract_name,ta.total_amount_inc_tax,ta.agreement_state, tpspr.procurement_scheme_id as scheme_id,ttn.notice_status, tmp.constrution_unit buildUnit, sd.dept_name responsibleUnit, tmp.prj_state projectBusinessCode, tmp.prg_type engineerTypeCode, tmp.jg_type structureTypeCode, tmp.actual_begin_date realityBeginDate, tmp.actual_end_date realityFinishDate, tmp.prj_addr_info address, tmp.state projectStatusName from tb_procurement_plan tpp left join tb_contract_planning tcp on tcp.plan_id = tpp.id left join tb_contract_planning_split tcps on tpp.id = tcps.procurement_plan_id left join tb_agreement ta on tcps.id = ta.contract_split_id left join tb_procurement_scheme_plan_relate tpspr on tpp.id = tpspr.procurement_plan_id left join tb_tender_notice ttn on tpspr.procurement_scheme_id = ttn.scheme_id left join tb_min_project tmp on tmp.min_account_code = tcp.project_code left join sys_dept sd on sd.thrid_dept_id = tmp.duty_unit
AND tcp.project_code like concat('%',#{projectCode},'%')
AND tcp.project_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
